description: This file declares the SessionServerApp class, which implements the ISessionServerApp interface for managing session server applications within the Rialto server manager. It includes class members, constructors, destructors, and method declarations related to launching, configuring, and controlling session server instances.

classes.name: SessionServerApp
classes.description: A class managing the lifecycle and configuration of a session server instance, including startup, shutdown, and socket management.

methods.name: isPreloaded
methods.description: Checks if the session server is preloaded.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the session server with application name, initial state, and app configuration.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the session server is connected.

methods.name: getSessionManagementSocketName
methods.description: Returns the name of the session management socket.

methods.name: getSessionManagementSocketPermissions
methods.description: Returns the permissions of the session management socket.

methods.name: getInitialState
methods.description: Returns the initial state of the session server.

methods.name: getAppManagementSocketName
methods.description: Returns the app management socket name.

methods.name: getMaxPlaybackSessions
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of playback sessions.

methods.name: getMaxWebAudioPlayers
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of Web Audio players.
